title: Organization
description: An Organization represents a brand, partner, or ad agency on the Snapchat advertising platform.

id.description: The unique identifier of the organization

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the organization was last updated

created_at.description: The timestamp when the organization was created

address_line_1.description: First line of the organization address

locality.description: City or locality of the organization

administrative_district_level_1.description: State or province of the organization

my_display_name.description: The display name of the authenticated user within this organization

my_invited_email.description: The email address used to invite the authenticated user

my_member_id.description: The member ID of the authenticated user within this organization
